cases.description: Booking exactly the remaining ticket capacity is rejected by >= even though it should be allowed; boundary test missing.
The delivery ID is marked as seen before publish resolves. If publish rejects, subsequent retry is classified duplicate and never delivered.
Monthly customer aggregation checks UTC month but not the specified year, causing previous-year charges in the same month to be included.

cleanControls.contract: Only allow mailto/tel schemes with bounded normalized values; malformed, query-injection and unsafe inputs rejected in fixtures.
cleanControls.caveat: Passing focused tests is not proof of full RFC coverage.

cleanControls.contract: Per-key lock remains held until the awaited callback settles; finally releases it after success or failure.
cleanControls.caveat: Only a single-process lock; intentionally not a distributed lock.

testWeaknessesNotSeparatelyScored: Capacity tests do not exercise exact-fit booking.
Delivery tests do not simulate publish failure and later retry.
Monthly summary tests do not mix the same month across different years.

scoringRules.primary: Match three distinct runtime findings to the exact changed paths and added-line ranges, with evidence for the behavioral counterexample.
scoringRules.negativeControls: Manually examine any findings on cleanControls for concrete counterexamples; do not automatically equate them to false positives.
scoringRules.extras: Genuine test-effectiveness observations are supplementary and not scored as extra runtime defects.

precautions: All values synthetic. Reference answers are in a separate ReviewForge development branch, not this sandbox PR. Do not feed gold to reviewer. Single authorized shadow review only. No Proffera writes, merge, GitHub comments or repeat charge.
limitation: One intentionally constructed benchmark cannot establish real-world precision/recall; independently validate every output.
